name: Can I add items to the punch list after it has been finalized?

mainEntity.name: Can I add items to the punch list after it has been finalized?

acceptedAnswer.text: Generally, once a punch list is formally signed off or considered finalized, adding new items can be challenging and may be considered new work or change orders. The intention of a punch list is to capture all remaining items at a specific point in time. It is important to thoroughly review the property during the initial walk-through. For Frasheski Construction, we encourage clients to be comprehensive during the initial walk-through in Berkeley, East Bay, or other service areas, as identifying all items upfront helps us manage the project timeline and resources efficiently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Adding items after a punch list is finalized is generally not possible and may be considered new work; thorough initial review is crucial.
